scope: Limely marka kimliği ve renkleriyle farklı yerleşimli danışan ve diyetisyen ekran konseptleri. Onaylı logo, maskot ve karşılama dosyaları değiştirilmedi. Uygulama koduna uygulanmadı.
mobile:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Design a BRAND NEW, ORIGINAL high-fidelity Turkish mobile nutrition app home screen for "limely". The ONLY supplied image is an APPROVED BRAND IDENTITY reference: preserve the simple green lime fruit symbol, lowercase rounded limely wordmark, and recognizable friendly sage round lime mascot with tiny face, single green leaf and yellow segmented citrus wedge. This is NOT a reference for layout. Create a genuinely distinct product interface from scratch.

Art direction: calm contemporary editorial wellness app, Manrope-like headings, Inter-like body, restrained semibold typography, broad unboxed whitespace, crisp thin icons, strong left alignment, a more designed visual hierarchy than a stack of soft statistic cards. Colors EXACTLY warm ivory #F8FAF2, forest ink #203B2F, primary pale lime #C9E879, sage #83B977, pale green #EAF3DE, occasional citrus yellow #F5D96A. Dark ink text on lime buttons, white text only on dark backgrounds. Use the brand's approved wordmark lettering ONLY for the logo; interface text is cleaner, not bubbly. Single full-bleed portrait mobile screen, realistic 390x844 logical proportions rendered at high resolution. No hardware frame, no exterior annotations.

NEW COMPOSITION, from top to bottom:
1. Slim masthead: small approved lime logo + "limely" left; discreet notification bell with tiny unread dot and circular "EY" profile at right. White/ivory, no chunky header.
2. Editorial header: tiny upper label "24 KASIM · SALI" with a small "Bugün" date dropdown aligned right. Large two-line headline "Günün, senin ritminde." Underneath tiny subtitle "Elif, bugün kendine iyi gelecek bir adım seç." Do NOT use a huge "Günaydın" greeting or a 7-day tile row.
3. Daily energy as a compact UNBOXED horizontal meter with label left "Günlük enerji", right "425 / 1.495 kcal"; thin palegreen horizontal track about 28% forest/lime fill; underneath tiny text "1 / 6 öğün tamamlandı". This is a small supporting indicator, NOT the hero.
4. The HERO is the next meal, an elegantly composed large landscape card, dark forest green background with a photographic overhead plate of grilled chicken, bulgur and green salad on the upper/right side. Photo occupies about one-third of the card and feels integrated; warm natural food photo, no human, no stock watermark. Left text "SIRADAKİ ÖĞÜN" small lime overline, "Öğle vakti" white strong heading, pill "13:00". Under it short readable list "Izgara tavuk · Bulgur · Salata". At bottom ONE main full-width lime action "Öğünümü kaydet" with small plus icon, dark text. Hero has 18px corners, not giant bubbly corners.
5. Below a small section "Günlük ritmin". Water is a FULL-WIDTH compact horizontal strip with pale green background: left a small instance of the EXACT approved lime mascot holding a glass; center "Su molası" then "750 / 2.000 ml"; right a compact outlined action "+ 250 ml". Under the value very small "3 / 8 bardak · 250 ml/bardak". Show ONE small bottle silhouette meter as a tiny accent if space permits. NO repeated glasses grid. No calorie/water side-by-side cards.
6. A quiet unboxed appointment row under a hairline divider: tiny calendar icon, "Defne ile görüşme" with "Cuma · 18:30" on a second line; chevron on right. No giant appointment card.
7. At bottom a simple white/ivory navigation BAR with subtle top hairline and five evenly spaced dark outline icons and labels "Günüm", "Planım", "Ölçüm", "Sohbet", "Hesabım". Active Günüm has a small forest-green underline/dot, not a big colored pill or a floating rounded navbar.

Strictly avoid: circular calorie ring, 7 weekday pills, eight-glass grid, four KPI tiles, ornamental colored quarter-circles, a generic rounded-stat-card dashboard, broad top promotional banners. Do NOT recreate the earlier Tazeli layout or previous Limely screen. Keep key information legible, food hero primary, supporting progress lightweight. All Turkish text spelled perfectly, hierarchy fits the complete screen without overlap. Use consistent 18px corners for main card and 12px for smaller elements. No extra menus/features, no fabricated medical advice, no copyright/brand claims, no title outside screen.
panel:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a BRAND NEW, ORIGINAL high-fidelity desktop workspace for the Turkish dietitian platform "limely". The supplied image is ONLY the approved BRAND IDENTITY reference for the exact green lime symbol, friendly lowercase limely wordmark, and round sage lime mascot with leaf, tiny face and segmented yellow citrus wedge. Do not use its composition as UI inspiration. This is a fresh UX design, not a reskin of another dashboard.

Output one polished high-resolution LANDSCAPE desktop app screen, about 1800x1100, complete legible interface, no device frame or exterior titles. Deliberately original top-navigation workstation layout, strong typographic hierarchy, compact operational density, restrained 12-16px corners and fine rules. Forest #203B2F, warm ivory #F8FAF2, white, primary lime #C9E879, sage #83B977 and quiet palegreen #EAF3DE, subtle citrus yellow #F5D96A as a rare minor accent. Interface uses clean Manrope-like semibold headings and Inter-like body/numerals. Only approved brand wordmark stays rounded. Main action buttons lime with forest text; no neon, no white text on lime.

NONNEGOTIABLE NEW INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE:
- NO left sidebar at all.
- NO broad promotional/mascot/greeting banner.
- NO four statistic tiles across the top.
- NO decorative colored quarter circles.
- NO oversized bubbly heading typography.
- NO original Tazeli appointments-list-and-overdue-card layout.

TOP APPLICATION HEADER, about 76px high: small approved lime fruit + "limely" on far left. Horizontal main navigation through center: "Çalışma alanı" active with a thin green underline, "Danışanlar", "Planlar", "Takvim", "Mesajlar" tiny badge 2, "İşletme" dropdown. Right small search icon, notification icon, circular profile "DA". A fine divider beneath header.
PAGE INTRO on ivory: left small date "24 Kasım 2026 · Salı", heading "Bugünün akışı", then small UNBOXED inline facts "5 görüşme bugün  ·  16 aktif danışan". At right two compact actions outlined "+ Danışan" and primary lime "Plan hazırla". This is a quiet page title area, not a hero or banner.
MAIN WORKSPACE: two asymmetrical columns approximately 72% / 28%, no left rail.
LEFT PRIMARY AREA is a large WEEKLY CALENDAR surface with a hairline boundary and restrained 14px corners. Header "Haftalık takvim", week "23–27 Kasım", small previous/next arrows and "Bu hafta" button. Main calendar shows 5 weekdays "Pzt 23", "Sal 24" highlighted as today's column, "Çar 25", "Per 26", "Cum 27". Time labels 09:00 through 18:00 on a fine grid. Include realistically spaced events, not overcrowded: Monday 10:00 Selin Koç and 14:00 Murat Aksoy; Tuesday 13:00 Kerem Kaya, 14:00 Gizem Arslan, 15:00 Fatma Polat, 16:00 Murat Aksoy and 17:00 Merve Doğan; Wednesday 11:00 Ayşe Erdem; Thursday 14:00 Emre Öztürk; Friday 16:00 Elif Yılmaz. Event blocks soft sage/lime with forest lettering, one selected Tuesday event dark forest with white lettering, subtle tiny video icon for online visits. Large calendar must be the focal point.
RIGHT SECONDARY AREA is an UNBOXED compact work queue on an offwhite surface, with heading "Sıradaki işlemler" and small count "4". Four actionable rows separated by hairlines, not giant individual cards:
"Elif Yılmaz" — "Haftalık planı hazırla" — small text action "Planı aç →".
"Emre Öztürk" — "Yeni ölçüm kaydı" — "İncele →".
"Ayşe Erdem" — "Yeni mesaj" — "Yanıtla →".
"Murat Aksoy" — "Pakette 1 seans kaldı" — "Paketi incele →".
Use tiny understated status icons, each row with at most 2 lines + discreet action. Below queue a small quiet branded corner: approved mascot at 50px next to "Küçük adımlar, düzenli takip." No marketing banner and no huge cartoon.
BOTTOM AREA under the calendar and queue: one full-width clean CLIENT FOLLOW-UP TABLE, heading "Danışan takibi", small tabs "Tümü · 16" and "İlgi bekleyen · 4", discreet client search. Columns "Danışan", "Plan", "Son kayıt", "Durum", "İşlem". Three visible sample rows: "Elif Yılmaz" / "Haftalık plan" / "3 gün önce" / "Plan hazır" / small arrow; "Emre Öztürk" / "Online takip" / "8 gün önce" / "Ölçüm bekleniyor" / arrow; "Ayşe Erdem" / "Haftalık plan" / "Bugün" / "Yeni mesaj" / arrow. Rows have quiet horizontal separators, names left aligned, minimal badges. No giant avatars and no dense filler prose.
Fit the full header, title, calendar, task queue and table into the complete viewport. Preserve real readable Turkish words and dates, consistent icons and realistic spacing. The result should feel like a purpose-built professional clinic workstation belonging to Limely and visually unlike the previous/reference dashboard. No external sales text, Briefikir, demo advertising, branded supplier links, copyright or uniqueness claims.
